app_user_phone_format.name: app_user_phone_format
app_user_phone_format.value:
("app_user"."whatsapp_phone" IS NULL OR "app_user"."whatsapp_phone" ~ '^\+?[0-9]{9,15}$')
        AND ("app_user"."other_phone" IS NULL OR "app_user"."other_phone" ~ '^\+?[0-9]{9,15}$')
        AND ("app_user"."introduced_by_phone" IS NULL OR "app_user"."introduced_by_phone" ~ '^\+?[0-9]{9,15}$')

book_request_steps.name: book_request_steps
book_request_steps.value:
CASE "book_request"."status"
        WHEN 'requested' THEN "book_request"."copy_id" IS NULL AND "book_request"."decided_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'declined' THEN "book_request"."copy_id" IS NULL AND "book_request"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "book_request"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "book_request"."decline_reason" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'cancelled' THEN "book_request"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'accepted' THEN "book_request"."copy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "book_request"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "book_request"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "book_request"."dispatched_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'in_transit' THEN "book_request"."copy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "book_request"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "book_request"."arrived_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'held' THEN "book_request"."arrived_at" IS NOT NULL AND "book_request"."hold_until" IS NOT NULL
          AND "book_request"."borrow_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'issued' THEN "book_request"."borrow_id" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'lapsed' THEN "book_request"."lapsed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "book_request"."borrow_id" IS NULL
          AND "book_request"."return_dispatched_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'returning' THEN "book_request"."copy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "book_request"."return_arrived_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'completed' THEN "book_request"."return_arrived_at" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'lost_in_transit' THEN "book_request"."copy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "book_request"."lost_reason" IS NOT NULL
      END

book_settlement_amounts.name: book_settlement_amounts
book_settlement_amounts.value:
"book_settlement"."set_amount_cents" > 0 AND "book_settlement"."amount_due_cents" > 0
        AND "book_settlement"."amount_due_cents" <= "book_settlement"."set_amount_cents"
        AND ("book_settlement"."tariff_cents" IS NULL OR "book_settlement"."tariff_cents" >= 0)
        AND ("book_settlement"."tariff_cents" IS NULL OR "book_settlement"."tariff_cents" = "book_settlement"."set_amount_cents"
          OR "book_settlement"."amount_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("book_settlement"."amount_due_cents" = "book_settlement"."set_amount_cents" OR "book_settlement"."reduction_reason" IS NOT NULL)

book_settlement_window.name: book_settlement_window
book_settlement_window.value:
"book_settlement"."window_ends" > "book_settlement"."declared_on"
        AND ("book_settlement"."window_extended_days" IS NULL) = ("book_settlement"."window_extension_reason" IS NULL)
        AND ("book_settlement"."window_extended_days" IS NULL OR "book_settlement"."window_extended_days" > 0)

book_settlement_outcome.name: book_settlement_outcome
book_settlement_outcome.value:
CASE "book_settlement"."status"
        WHEN 'open' THEN "book_settlement"."settled_on" IS NULL AND "book_settlement"."replacement_copy_id" IS NULL
          AND "book_settlement"."waiver_reason" IS NULL
        WHEN 'replaced' THEN "book_settlement"."settled_on" IS NOT NULL AND "book_settlement"."replacement_copy_id" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'paid' THEN "book_settlement"."settled_on" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'waived' THEN "book_settlement"."settled_on" IS NOT NULL AND "book_settlement"."waiver_reason" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'found' THEN "book_settlement"."settled_on" IS NOT NULL AND "book_settlement"."found_on" IS NOT NULL
      END
      AND ("book_settlement"."found_on" IS NULL) = ("book_settlement"."found_reason" IS NULL)

borrow_extension_waiting_idx.name: borrow_extension_waiting_idx
borrow_extension_waiting_idx.where: "borrow"."extension_status" = 'requested' AND "borrow"."returned_on" IS NULL AND "borrow"."voided_at" IS NULL

borrow_extension.name: borrow_extension
borrow_extension.value:
CASE "borrow"."extension_status"
        WHEN 'none' THEN "borrow"."extension_requested_at" IS NULL AND "borrow"."extension_decided_at" IS NULL
          AND "borrow"."extension_decided_by" IS NULL AND "borrow"."extension_reason" IS NULL
        WHEN 'requested' THEN "borrow"."extension_requested_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "borrow"."extension_decided_at" IS NULL AND "borrow"."extension_decided_by" IS NULL
          AND "borrow"."extension_reason" IS NULL
        WHEN 'approved' THEN "borrow"."extension_decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "borrow"."extension_decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "borrow"."extension_reason" IS NULL
        WHEN 'declined' THEN "borrow"."extension_decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "borrow"."extension_decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "borrow"."extension_reason" IS NOT NULL
      END

borrow_dates.name: borrow_dates
borrow_dates.value:
"borrow"."due_date" > "borrow"."borrow_date" AND "borrow"."original_due_date" > "borrow"."borrow_date"
        AND "borrow"."due_date" >= "borrow"."original_due_date"
        AND ("borrow"."returned_on" IS NULL OR "borrow"."returned_on" >= "borrow"."borrow_date")

borrow_received_when_returned.name: borrow_received_when_returned
borrow_received_when_returned.value:
("borrow"."returned_on" IS NULL) = ("borrow"."received_by" IS NULL AND "borrow"."lost_declared_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("borrow"."received_by" IS NULL OR "borrow"."lost_declared_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("borrow"."lost_declared_at" IS NULL) = ("borrow"."lost_declared_by" IS NULL)

borrow_void_complete.name: borrow_void_complete
borrow_void_complete.value:
("borrow"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("borrow"."void_reason" IS NULL)
        AND ("borrow"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("borrow"."voided_by" IS NULL)

branch_setting_positive.name: branch_setting_positive
branch_setting_positive.value:
"branch_setting"."loan_days" > 0 AND "branch_setting"."max_books" > 0 AND "branch_setting"."max_books_while_settling" >= 0
        AND "branch_setting"."max_books_while_settling" <= "branch_setting"."max_books" AND "branch_setting"."settlement_window_days" > 0
        AND "branch_setting"."staff_due_warning_days" >= 0 AND "branch_setting"."member_due_warning_days" >= 0
        AND "branch_setting"."decline_grace_days" >= 0 AND "branch_setting"."hold_days" > 0 AND "branch_setting"."transit_alert_days" > 0 AND "branch_setting"."application_stale_days" > 0
        AND "branch_setting"."application_anonymise_days" > 0 AND "branch_setting"."renewal_grace_days" >= 0
        AND "branch_setting"."frequent_late_count" > 0 AND "branch_setting"."frequent_late_months" > 0
        AND "branch_setting"."log_retention_months" >= 24

membership_payment_by_kind.name: membership_payment_by_kind
membership_payment_by_kind.value:
CASE "membership_payment"."kind"
        WHEN 'fee' THEN "membership_payment"."amount_cents" > 0 AND "membership_payment"."receipt_no" IS NOT NULL
          AND "membership_payment"."extends_to" IS NOT NULL AND "membership_payment"."reverses_payment_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'first_fee' THEN "membership_payment"."amount_cents" > 0 AND "membership_payment"."receipt_no" IS NOT NULL
          AND "membership_payment"."extends_to" IS NOT NULL AND "membership_payment"."reverses_payment_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'waiver' THEN "membership_payment"."amount_cents" = 0 AND "membership_payment"."reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "membership_payment"."extends_to" IS NOT NULL AND "membership_payment"."reverses_payment_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'reversal' THEN "membership_payment"."amount_cents" <= 0 AND "membership_payment"."reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "membership_payment"."reverses_payment_id" IS NOT NULL
      END

settlement_payment_by_kind.name: settlement_payment_by_kind
settlement_payment_by_kind.value:
CASE "settlement_payment"."kind"
        WHEN 'payment' THEN "settlement_payment"."amount_cents" > 0 AND "settlement_payment"."receipt_no" IS NOT NULL
          AND "settlement_payment"."reverses_payment_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'reversal' THEN "settlement_payment"."amount_cents" < 0 AND "settlement_payment"."reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "settlement_payment"."reverses_payment_id" IS NOT NULL
      END
